quote.text: The money is in the follow-up.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No calls scheduled — check Calendly for any new bookings.
focus: BofA account ending 3001 dropped below $100 last night and FB Ads burn ~$35/day from that same account. Top up the ad funding source today before the card declines. A stalled ad set kills your only live lead flow (27+ leads) and Meta penalizes delivery on re-spend.

Inbox is dry on prospects for a fourth straight day, so the bottleneck is follow-up, not volume. Pull the 5 warmest of your 27+ FB leads in GHL and send each a direct booking-link text before noon. Zero of 27 have closed; unworked leads decay fast.

Outbound is running on one leg — Instantly billing lapsed, LinkedIn paused, Bland never launched, only FB group posts auto-fire at 9 AM. Reactivate one channel today: restore Instantly billing or fire 10 manual DMs. One fragile source producing zero closes is the whole risk right now.
